Define the number-average molecular weight M_n as the sum of N_i times M_i divided by the sum of N_i.
Use N_1=96 with M_1=56526 g/mol.
Use N_2=131 with M_2=92809 g/mol.
Use N_3=153 with M_3=115856 g/mol.
Use N_4=146 with M_4=126029 g/mol.
Compute the total number of molecules as 96+131+153+146=526.
Compute the total molecular weight contribution as 96*56526 + 131*92809 + 153*115856 + 146*126029 = 53,710,677 g/mol.
Divide 53,710,677 g/mol by 526 to get M_n = 102,112 g/mol.
Report the number-average molecular weight as 102,112 g/mol.
